integrity: The proof is unbounded and exhausts primes, prime squares, squarefree semiprimes, prime cubes, repeated-prime products, and squarefree three-prime products. The finite checker is corroborative only, and the sharpness witness \(90\) is verified exactly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only integers \(n>1\) with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). It does not classify the full \(\Omega(n)=4\) layer or higher multiplicity.
title: The first three multiplicity layers of an aliquot-sum/totient divisibility
